programme.title: Ask the Dust
programme.desc: Arturo Bandini is a writer who moves from Colorado to Los Angeles with aspirations of completing a great novel. There he meets bold Mexican waitress Camilla. She wants to live a better life and thinks marrying for money may be her answer. Arturo, who tries to project a confidence that he is inwardly lacking, initially acts coldly toward Camilla. Despite not seeming like a viable match, a romance gradually develops between the two. - Colin Farrell, Salma Hayek, Donald Sutherland, Idina Menzel, William Mapother (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Arthur Kipps, a lawyer, is recently widowed and grieving the loss of his wife when he is sent to a remote village to put a deceased eccentric's affairs in order. Soon after his arrival, it becomes clear that the villagers are hiding a terrible secret. Kipps discovers that his late client's house is haunted by the spirit of a woman who is trying to find someone and something she lost, and that no one -- not even the children -- is safe from her terrible wrath. - Daniel Radcliffe, Misha Handley, Roger Allam, Ciarán Hinds, Janet McTeer (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: Scary Movie V
programme.desc: Much bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn infant home from the hospital. When they realize that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal specialists and install numerous cameras to drive out the pesky spirit. Movies that are spoofed in the familiar format include the "Paranormal Activity" franchise, "Mama," "Sinister," "Evil Dead," "Inception," "Black Swan" and "Rise of the Planet of the Apes." - Ashley Tisdale, Simon Rex, Erica Ash, Katt Williams, Gracie Whitton (Comedy)

programme.title: Crawlspace
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. - Henry Thomas, Bradley Stryker, Jennifer Robertson, Olivia Taylor Dudley, C. Ernst Harth (Thriller)

programme.title: Winchester
programme.desc: The most haunted house in the world sits on an isolated stretch of land that's 50 miles outside of San Francisco. Built by Sarah Winchester, heiress to the Winchester fortune, it stands seven stories tall and contains hundreds of rooms. To an outsider, it looks like a monstrous monument to a disturbed woman's madness. But Sarah's actually building a prison, an asylum for hundreds of vengeful ghosts -- and the most terrifying among them have a score to settle with the Winchesters. - Helen Mirren, Jason Clarke, Sarah Snook, Angus Sampson, Laura Brent (Horror, Thriller, Biography, Drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: A hardworking and bright high-school senior, Leigh Ann (Katie Holmes) has her impending status as valedictorian jeopardized when her bitter history teacher, Mrs. Tingle (Helen Mirren), gives her a poor grade on a project. This antagonistic relationship quickly escalates until circumstances lead Leigh Ann and her friends Luke (Barry Watson) and Jo Lynn (Marisa Coughlan) to hold Tingle hostage in her home. As the conflict continues, it looks as if not everyone will make it out alive. - Helen Mirren, Katie Holmes, Jeffrey Tambor, Barry Watson, Marisa Coughlan (Comedy)

programme.title: Case 39
programme.desc: In her many years as a social worker, Emily Jenkins (Renée Zellweger) thinks she has seen it all -- until she meets 10-year-old Lilith (Jodelle Ferland) and the girl's cruel parents. When the parents try to harm the child, Emily assumes custody of Lilith while looking for a foster family. However, she soon finds that dark forces surround the seemingly innocent child, and the more she tries to protect Lilith, the more horrors she encounters. - Renée Zellweger, Jodelle Ferland, Ian McShane, Bradley Cooper, Kerry O'Malley (Horror, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Out of the Furnace
programme.desc: Steelworker Russell Baze works a dead-end job and holds tight to his sense of family, duty and loyalty. Rodney Baze, Russell's brother, returns home after serving in Iraq and, with his debts piling up, becomes entangled with a vicious crime lord. Soon afterward, Rodney disappears mysteriously. The police fail to solve the case, so Russell -- feeling he has little left to lose -- puts his life on the line to bring his brother home. - Christian Bale, Woody Harrelson, Casey Affleck, Forest Whitaker, Willem Dafoe (Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: For Greater Glory: The True Story of Cristiada
programme.desc: In late 1920s Mexico, retired Gen. Gorostieta and his wife watch their country degenerate into violent civil war when the government enacts a series of anti-clerical laws. Gorostieta is at first hesitant to join the rebels, known as Cristeros, until he begins to see the cost of religious persecution on his countrymen. Though the odds are against him, the general nevertheless transforms a ragtag band of rebels into a formidable fighting force. - Andy Garcia, Eva Longoria, Peter O'Toole, Oscar Isaac, Santiago Cabrera (Historical drama)

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Officer K (Ryan Gosling), a new Blade Runner for the Los Angeles Police Department, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. His discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard (Harrison Ford), a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years. - Ryan Gosling, Harrison Ford, Ana de Armas, Sylvia Hoeks, Robin Wright (Science fiction, Thriller, Action)

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.
Sparta's King Leonidas (Gerard Butler) and his badly outnumbered warriors fight to the death against King Xerxes' massive Persian army at the Battle of Thermopylae.

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Xerxes, driven by vengeance for his father's death, leads an army against Greece; Greek city-states join forces under Athens' command to fight Artemisia in a naval battle.

programme.title: Machine Gun Preacher
programme.desc: Sam Childers (Gerard Butler), a former biker, travels to Africa to establish an orphanage for young victims of war.

programme.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: With their futures threatened by false accusations of cheating, three teenagers take matters into their own hands.

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Constable Ichabod Crane is sent to the village of Sleepy Hollow, where a headless horseman is leaving a trail of decapitated bodies.

programme.title: Ghost in the Shell
programme.desc: A one-of-a-kind, cyber-enhanced soldier (Scarlett Johansson) must battle a new enemy who can hack into people's minds and control them.

programme.title: My Cousin Vinny
programme.desc: Two New Yorkers accused of murder in rural Alabama while on their way back to college call in the help of one of their cousins, a loudmouth lawyer with no trial experience.

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: A group of small town High School students, including an introverted photographer and a drug dealer, begin to suspect something's off with their teachers. They realize that the faculty is under the control of mind-controlling alien parasites.

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: A businessman embarks on a revenge-fueled vendetta after his daughter dies in a terrorist bombing. His search leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

programme.title: There Will Be Blood
programme.desc: Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) becomes a self-made oil tycoon, but he deviates into moral bankruptcy as his material fortune grows.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: A teenage girl (Hailee Steinfeld) enlists the aid of a boozy, trigger-happy lawman (Jeff Bridges) to hunt down her father's killer (Josh Brolin).

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Edge of Tomorrow
programme.desc: When Earth falls under attack from invincible aliens, no military unit in the world is able to beat them. Maj. William Cage (Tom Cruise), an officer who has never seen combat, is assigned to a suicide mission. Killed within moments, Cage finds himself thrown into a time loop, in which he relives the same brutal fight -- and his death -- over and over again. However, Cage's fighting skills improve with each encore, bringing him and a comrade (Emily Blunt) ever closer to defeating the aliens. - Tom Cruise, Emily Blunt, Brendan Gleeson, Bill Paxton, Jonas Armstrong (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City: A Dame to Kill For
programme.desc: The damaged denizens of Sin City return for another round of stories from the mind of Frank Miller. In "Just Another Saturday Night," Marv (Mickey Rourke) struggles to recall a nasty run-in with some frat boys. In "A Dame to Kill For," Dwight McCarthy (Josh Brolin) forsakes his battle with his inner demons to help Ava Lord (Eva Green), the woman of his dreams and nightmares. In "Nancy's Last Dance," Nancy Callahan (Jessica Alba), mad with grief and rage over Hartigan's death, vows revenge. - Mickey Rourke, Jessica Alba, Josh Brolin, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Rosario Dawson (Action, Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: On the eve of D-Day, American paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to penetrate the walls of a fortified church and destroy a radio transmitter. As the soldiers approach their target, they soon begin to realize that there's more going on in the Nazi-occupied village than a simple military operation. Making their way to an underground lab, the outnumbered men stumble upon a sinister experiment that forces them into a vicious battle against an army of the undead. - Jovan Adepo, Wyatt Russell, Pilou Asbæk, Mathilde Ollivier, John Magaro (Horror, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Marathon Man
programme.desc: Thomas "Babe" Levy (Dustin Hoffman) is a Columbia graduate student and long-distance runner who is oblivious to the fact that his older brother, Doc (Roy Scheider), is a government agent chasing down a Nazi war criminal (Laurence Olivier) -- that is, until Doc is murdered and Babe finds himself knee-deep in a tangle of stolen gems and sadistic madmen. Even his girlfriend, Elsa (Marthe Keller), becomes a suspect as everything Babe believed to be true is suddenly turned upside down. - Dustin Hoffman, Laurence Olivier, Roy Scheider, William Devane, Marthe Keller (Thriller, Action, Mystery, Drama, War)

programme.title: Joe Dirt
programme.desc: He's the wrong person, at the wrong place, at the wrong time. Joe Dirt (David Spade) is a janitor with a mullet hairdo, acid-washed jeans and a dream -- to find the parents that he lost at the Grand Canyon when he was eight. As his wandering, misguided search takes him from one misadventure to another, he finds his way to Los Angeles, where a shock-jock (Dennis Miller) brings Joe on the radio to insult him. But as Joe's story unfolds, jeers turn to cheers, and an entire city is captivated. - David Spade, Dennis Miller, Brittany Daniel, Kid Rock, Adam Beach (Comedy)

programme.title: The Lego Movie
programme.desc: An ordinary LEGO figurine Emmet who always follows the rules, is mistakenly identified as an extraordinary being and the key to saving the world. He finds himself drafted into a fellowship of strangers who are on a mission to stop an evil tyrant's plans to conquer the world. Unfortunately for Emmet, he is hopelessly and hilariously unprepared for such a task, but he'll give it his all nonetheless. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Smart People
programme.desc: Acerbic, selfish and widowed, literature professor Lawrence Wetherhold (Dennis Quaid) is estranged from his son and his overachieving teenage daughter. Just as he begins a relationship with a former student (Sarah Jessica Parker), Lawrence's ne'er-do-well adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church) lands on his doorstep. Lawrence realizes he must make some changes in his life and reconnect with his children in order to get on with his life. - Dennis Quaid, Sarah Jessica Parker, Thomas Haden Church, Ellen Page, Ashton Holmes (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Struggling boutique bookseller Kathleen Kelly hates Joe Fox, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity. Eventually Joe learns that the enchanting woman he's involved with is actually his business rival. He must now struggle to reconcile his real-life dislike for her with the cyber love he's come to feel. - Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan, Parker Posey, Greg Kinnear, Jean Stapleton (Drama, Romance, Comedy)

programme.title: The Hangover
programme.desc: Two days before his wedding, Doug (Justin Bartha) and three friends (Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis) drive to Las Vegas for a wild and memorable stag party. In fact, when the three groomsmen wake up the next morning, they can't remember a thing; nor can they find Doug. With little time to spare, the three hazy pals try to re-trace their steps and find Doug so they can get him back to Los Angeles in time to walk down the aisle. - Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis, Justin Bartha, Heather Graham (Comedy)

programme.title: The Hangover Part II
programme.desc: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. - Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis, Justin Bartha, Ken Jeong (Comedy)

programme.title: The Hangover Part III
programme.desc: It's been two years since the gang known as the Wolfpack narrowly escaped disaster in Bangkok. Now, Phil (Bradley Cooper), Stu (Ed Helms) and Doug (Justin Bartha) have happy lives at home -- but Alan (Zach Galifianakis) doesn't. Still lacking contentment and a sense of purpose, Alan has gone off his meds and surrendered to his natural impulses. It's up to the other members of the Wolfpack to get him through his personal crisis by embarking on a road trip to the place it all began: Las Vegas. - Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis, Justin Bartha, Ken Jeong (Comedy)

programme.title: Shell
programme.desc: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake gets drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon, only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath the seemingly flawless surface. - Elisabeth Moss, Kate Hudson, Arian Moayed, Este Haim, Elizabeth Berkley (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: The Honey Trap: A True Story of Love, Lies and the FBI
programme.desc: The story of Denis Cuspert, aka Deso Dogg, and his journey from infamous German rapper to ISIS recruiter; exploring the circular relationship between propaganda, recruitment and the soft power of entertainment culture. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: Wolves
programme.desc: Anthony is a standout player on his Manhattan high school's basketball team with seemingly everything going for him: a killer three-point shot, a loving girlfriend, and a chance at a scholarship to Cornell. But Anthony's dreams of playing college ball are jeopardized by his volatile father, a hard-drinking writer whose compulsive gambling threatens to derail the lives of both his wife and son. - Michael Shannon, Carla Gugino, Taylor John Smith, Chris Bauer, John Douglas Thompson (Drama)

programme.title: Personality Crisis: One Night Only
programme.desc: A portrait of musician David Johansen from Martin Scorsese and David Tedeschi; featuring a live performance at Café Carlyle in New York City, along with new and archival interviews. (Special, Documentary, Music)

programme.title: B******': The Sound and Fury of Rick James
programme.desc: A raw and intimate documentary look at the wildly colorful life of legendary funk artist Rick James; original interviews with artists, collaborators and friends. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: Before Dawn
programme.desc: A young man joins his countrymen on the Western front of World War I, hoping to expedite an end to the bloody conflict. However, as the battle rages on, he's forced to grapple with the brutal realities of trench warfare, including a near-constant struggle to keep himself alive without leaving another man behind. - Levi Miller, Travis Jeffery, Myles Pollard, Tim Franklin, Jordan Dulieu (War, Historical drama)

programme.title: Rumours
programme.desc: Leaders of the world's wealthiest democracies gather for the annual G7 summit to draft a provisional statement regarding a global crisis. They soon become spectacles of incompetence, contending with increasingly surreal obstacles as night falls in the misty woods, and they realize they are suddenly alone. - Cate Blanchett, Roy Dupuis, Denis Ménochet, Charles Dance, Nikki Amuka-Bird (Comedy, Horror)

programme.title: Masterminds
programme.desc: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him. - Zach Galifianakis, Owen Wilson, Kristen Wiig, Ross Kimball, Devin Ratray (Comedy, Action)

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden. - Kevin James, Christina Ricci, Luis Guzmán, Melissa Leo, Francis Cronin (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
programme.desc: Fearless explorer Lara Croft (Angelina Jolie) tries to locate Pandora's box before criminals Jonathan Reiss (Ciarán Hinds) and Chen Lo (Simon Yam) use it for evil. According to myth, the box holds deadly organisms that could kill millions of people. With her old partner, Terry (Gerard Butler), Croft goes on a hunt that takes her from Europe to Asia to Africa, where pal Kosa (Djimon Hounsou) helps her. Along the way, Croft rappels down cliffs, scuba dives and decimates many male opponents. - Angelina Jolie, Gerard Butler, Ciarán Hinds, Christopher Barrie, Noah Taylor (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: The Ghostface Killer returns with a vengeance when self-help author Sidney Prescott arrives in Woodsboro on the last stop of her book tour.

programme.title: Scouts Guide to the Zombie Apocalypse
programme.desc: Three Boy Scouts (Tye Sheridan, Logan Miller, Joey Morgan) join forces with a tough cocktail waitress (Sarah Dumont) to save their once-peaceful town from a zombie invasion.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: An elite hitman teaches his trade to an apprentice who has a connection to one of his previous victims.

programme.title: Erotic Experiment
programme.desc: A couple attempts to save their marriage via a tempting radical solution.

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: The Ghostface Killer returns with a vengeance when self-help author Sidney Prescott arrives in Woodsboro on the last stop of her book tour.

programme.title: Masterminds
programme.desc: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him.

programme.title: Just Another Immigrant: Romesh at the Greek
programme.desc: Romesh Ranganathan, a successful comedian in England, moves his entire family to Los Angeles to make it as a comedian in America; he then takes the drastic step of performing his first ever U.S. stand-up show at the historic Greek Theatre.

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: A beautiful globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) battles otherworldly creatures for possession of a powerful artifact.

programme.title: Tale of the Mummy
programme.desc: A woman (Louise Lombard) investigates the mysterious disappearance of her grandfather at the tomb of an Egyptian prince 50 years earlier.

programme.title: Changing Lanes
programme.desc: An attorney and a recovering alcoholic have a car accident which swiftly escalates into an ongoing, bitter feud.

programme.title: The Hangover
programme.desc: After a wild stag party in Las Vegas, three hazy groomsmen (Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis) must find their missing friend and get him back to Los Angeles in time for his wedding.

programme.title: The Hangover Part II
programme.desc: Hoping to avoid the mayhem that marked his friend's Las Vegas bachelor party, Stu opts for what he thinks will be a safe prewedding brunch in Thailand.

programme.title: The Hangover Part III
programme.desc: Phil, Stu and Doug take Alan on a road trip to help him through a personal crisis. Mr. Chow breaks out of prison and prepares to wreak havoc.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: After discovering a long-buried secret that jeopardizes what's left of society, a new Blade Runner embarks on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years.

programme.title: Se7en
programme.desc: A meticulous detective and the young officer about to replace the veteran probe serial murders based on the seven deadly sins.

programme.title: Out of the Furnace
programme.desc: Steelworker Russell Baze works a dead-end job and holds tight to his sense of family, duty and loyalty. Rodney Baze, Russell's brother, returns home after serving in Iraq and, with his debts piling up, becomes entangled with a vicious crime lord. Soon afterward, Rodney disappears mysteriously. The police fail to solve the case, so Russell -- feeling he has little left to lose -- puts his life on the line to bring his brother home. - Christian Bale, Woody Harrelson, Casey Affleck, Forest Whitaker, Willem Dafoe (Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Every Breath You Take
programme.desc: A psychiatrist's life gets turned upside down when a patient takes her own life, and he introduces her brother to his own family. - Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan, Sam Claflin, India Eisley, Emily Alyn Lind (Thriller)

programme.title: The Yards
programme.desc: After serving time in prison for taking the fall for a group of his friends, Leo just wants to get his life back on track. So he goes to the one place he thinks will be safe -- home. There he takes a new job with his highly connected and influential uncle. But in the yards, where his uncle now pulls the strings, safe is not how they do business. Unwittingly, he's drawn into a world of sabotage, high stakes payoffs and even murder. - Mark Wahlberg, Joaquin Phoenix, Charlize Theron, James Caan, Ellen Burstyn (Crime drama)

programme.title: Sweet Virginia
programme.desc: An ex-rodeo rider strikes up a friendship with a young man who may be behind the violence occurring in their small town. - Jon Bernthal, Christopher Abbott, Imogen Poots, Rosemarie DeWitt, Odessa Young (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Below
programme.desc: The submarine U.S.S. Manta had a perfect record until the mysterious death of its captain. The next-in-command, Lt. Richard Brice (Bruce Greenwood) is determined to steer his disheartened crew back to safety. But after three battle survivors board the sub, bizarre and frightening things begin to happen. As the tale unfolds, and crew members begin to disappear, Ensign Douglas O'Dell (Matthew Davis) must piece together the puzzles of the submarine's past before it is too late to resurface alive. - Matthew Davis, Bruce Greenwood, Olivia Williams, Holt McCallany, Scott Foley (Thriller)

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis). - Tom Cruise, Kelly McGillis, Anthony Edwards, Val Kilmer, Tom Skerritt (Action, Adventure, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case. - Morgan Freeman, Monica Potter, Michael Wincott, Penelope Ann Miller, Michael Moriarty (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Due Justice
programme.desc: Consumed by grief and driven by revenge, a former Marine embarks on a relentless mission to hunt down those responsible for the brutal murders of his beloved wife and daughter. - Kellan Lutz, Jeff Fahey, Efren Ramirez, Cynthia Geary, Manu Intiraymi (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: In the tiny town of Brixton, Georgia where nothing is private, a woman with supernatural clairvoyance, a young beautiful socialite who has mysteriously disappeared, and an assortment of colorful characters all collide. A haunting psychological thriller, "The Gift" is ultimately a profound celebration of the human spirit. - Cate Blanchett, Giovanni Ribisi, Keanu Reeves, Katie Holmes, Greg Kinnear (Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: While investigating the murder of a fellow officer, veteran Renee Lomito discovers a mysterious figure in the body cam footage. Haunted by visions of the event, she suspects something supernatural is targeting the cops in her unit. Now, in a race against time to find the one person who can stop these killings, Renee uncovers a sinister secret among the police force surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth. - Mary J. Blige, Nat Wolff, David Zayas, Anika Noni Rose, Demetrius Grosse (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: A spaceship missing for seven years finally re-emerges and sends out a distress signal. But when a team is sent out to investigate, they discover that something sinister has taken over the craft. - Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson, Richard T. Jones (Science fiction, Horror)

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: No, this animated series is not about anthropomorphic chewing gum, it's about a young cat named Gumball Watterson. Gumball has a penchant for getting into trouble, often resulting from schemes he comes up with, but he never seems to learn his lesson. Gumball's best friend is a fish named Darwin, who used to be the family pet until he grew legs and became part of the family. Gumball resents his younger sister, Anais, because she is the smartest member of the family. Gumball's mother is the breadwinner in the family, working long hours at the rainbow factory, and his father stays at home watching TV and playing video games. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Bundesliga Soccer - FC Bayern München vs. VfB Stuttgart
programme.desc: FC Bayern Munich hosts VfB Stuttgart at Allianz Arena for the Bundesliga Matchday 1 opener. The home squad Bayern looks to build on a 3-0 victory from the May 2026 DFB-Pokal final, while visiting Stuttgart targets a road win in the opener. (Soccer)

programme.title: Bundesliga Soccer - RB Leipzig vs. Borussia Mönchengladbach
programme.desc: RB Leipzig hosts Borussia Mönchengladbach at Red Bull Arena for a Matchday 1 Bundesliga opening fixture. The home side Leipzig looks to repeat a 1-0 April win over Mönchengladbach, while Gladbach aims for a turnaround in this match. (Soccer)

programme.title: Bundesliga Soccer - 1. FSV Mainz 05 vs. SC Paderborn
programme.desc: 1. FSV Mainz 05 hosts SC Paderborn 07 at MEWA Arena for a Bundesliga matchday 1 fixture. Both teams look to build early momentum, as Mainz looks to replicate the form of its 2-0 win against Heidenheim, while Paderborn aims for a road turnaround. (Soccer)

programme.title: Bundesliga Soccer - 1. FC Köln vs. TSG 1899 Hoffenheim
programme.desc: The Bundesliga season opens at RheinEnergieStadion asCologne welcomes Hoffenheim in Matchday 1. Both sides arrive with DFB-Pokal victories - Cologne defeated Würzburger Kickers 2-1, while Hoffenheim won against Erzgebirge Aue 4-0. (Soccer)

programme.title: Bundesliga Soccer - 1. FC Union Berlin vs. Eintracht Frankfurt
programme.desc: Union Berlin and Eintracht Frankfurt meet for Matchday 1 of the Bundesliga season at Stadion An der Alten Försterei. Union Berlin previously defeated FC Augsburg 4-0 in May, while Frankfurt secured a 2-2 draw against Stuttgart in the last season. (Soccer)

programme.title: Bundesliga Soccer - SV 07 Elversberg vs. Bayer 04 Leverkusen
programme.desc: SV Elversberg and Bayer Leverkusen meet for a Matchday 1 of the Bundesliga season at URSAPHARM-Arena an der Kaiserlinde. This is the first meeting between the two teams. Bayer Leverkusen had a 1-1 draw against Hamburger SV in the last season. (Soccer)

programme.title: Bundesliga Soccer - Borussia Dortmund vs. Hamburger SV
programme.desc: Borussia Dortmund play hosts to Hamburger SV at Signal Iduna Park to open Matchday 1 of Bundesliga. Dortmund looks to bounce back from its 3-2 loss to Arsenal, while Hamburg looks to break away from a 1-1 draw against Leverkusen last season in May. (Soccer)

programme.title: Bundesliga Soccer - SC Freiburg vs. Werder Bremen
programme.desc: SC Freiburg and Werder Bremen meet at Europa-Park Stadion to open Matchday 1 of Bundesliga. Both teams look to bounce back from last season, as Werder lost to Dortmund 2-0, while Freiburg looks to bounce back from its 0-3 loss to Villa in May. (Soccer)

programme.title: Bundesliga Soccer - FC Augsburg vs. FC Schalke 04
programme.desc: FC Augsburg and FC Schalke 04 meet at WWK Arena to open Matchday 1 of the Bundesliga season. Augsburg looks to bounce back from a 4-0 loss to Berlin last season, while Schalke looks to build on a 1-0 win against Braunschweig from May. (Soccer)

programme.title: The Babysitter
programme.desc: Jennifer (Alicia Silverstone) is a lovely teen who has been hired to baby-sit the kids of Harry Tucker (J.T. Walsh) and his wife, Dolly (Lee Garlington). The Tuckers go to a party and proceed to get inebriated, with Mr. Tucker fantasizing about his beautiful babysitter. Meanwhile, Jack (Jeremy London), her boyfriend, and Mark (Nicky Katt), another guy interested in her, decide to spy on Jennifer at the Tucker house, with each young man also fixated on her. - Alicia Silverstone, Jeremy London, J.T. Walsh, Lee Garlington, Nicky Katt (Thriller)

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. - Michael Douglas, Glenn Close, Anne Archer, Ellen Hamilton Latzen, Stuart Pankin (Thriller, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins. - Juliette Binoche, Johnny Depp, Lena Olin, Judi Dench, Alfred Molina (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Smart People
programme.desc: Acerbic, selfish and widowed, literature professor Lawrence Wetherhold (Dennis Quaid) is estranged from his son and his overachieving teenage daughter. Just as he begins a relationship with a former student (Sarah Jessica Parker), Lawrence's ne'er-do-well adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church) lands on his doorstep. Lawrence realizes he must make some changes in his life and reconnect with his children in order to get on with his life. - Dennis Quaid, Sarah Jessica Parker, Thomas Haden Church, Ellen Page, Ashton Holmes (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life. - Renée Zellweger, Colin Firth, Hugh Grant, Gemma Jones, Jim Broadbent (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: They
programme.desc: Julia (Laura Regan), a smart, athletic psychology student is finally starting to get her life together. As a kid she was traumatized by night terrors, but now she is cruising towards a successful career as a psychologist and has a rock solid EMT boyfriend to boot (Marc Blucas). After a friend commits suicide - saying the night terrors have returned - Julia and some of her other friends start to experience the same terrors... - Laura Regan, Marc Blucas, Ethan Embry, Dagmara Dominczyk, Jon Abrahams (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. - Neve Campbell, David Arquette, Courteney Cox, Matthew Lillard, Skeet Ulrich (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead. - David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Jamie Kennedy (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Framed for the murder of her husband, Libby Parsons (Ashley Judd) survives the long years in prison with two burning desires sustaining her -- finding her son and solving the mystery that destroyed her once-happy life. Standing between her and her quest, however, is her parole officer, Travis Lehman (Tommy Lee Jones). Libby poses a challenge to the cynical officer, one that forces him to face up to his own failings while pitting him against his superiors and law enforcement colleagues. - Tommy Lee Jones, Ashley Judd, Bruce Greenwood, Annabeth Gish, Roma Maffia (Thriller, Crime drama, Action, Dark comedy, Mystery)

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: Frankie Dunn (Clint Eastwood) is a veteran Los Angeles boxing trainer who keeps almost everyone at arm's length, except his old friend and associate Eddie "Scrap Iron" Dupree (Morgan Freeman). When Maggie Fitzgerald (Hilary Swank) arrives in Frankie's gym seeking his expertise, he is reluctant to train the young woman, a transplant from working-class Missouri. Eventually, he relents, and the two form a close bond that will irrevocably change them both. - Clint Eastwood, Hilary Swank, Morgan Freeman, Anthony Mackie, Jay Baruchel (Drama)

programme.title: Babel
programme.desc: A tragic accident's scope expands, catching four groups of people on three continents in its terrible grip.

programme.title: Dead Man Walking
programme.desc: A nun helps a double murderer deal with his actions and prepare for his execution in a New Orleans prison.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Telling fortunes to support herself and her daughter, a psychic widow (Cate Blanchett) assists the police in a missing persons case.

programme.title: Frida
programme.desc: Mexican painter Frida Kahlo (Salma Hayek) marries fellow artist Diego Rivera who shares her radical political views.

programme.title: Smart People
programme.desc: Recently widowed, a professor (Dennis Quaid) tries to juggle a new love (Sarah Jessica Parker) and an unexpected visit from his adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church).

programme.title: I Used to Go Here
programme.desc: A successful author finds herself deeply enmeshed in the lives of a group of college students after being asked to speak at her alma mater.

programme.title: Band Aid
programme.desc: A bickering couple make one last effort to save their marriage by turning their arguments into songs and forming a band.

programme.title: Emily Bronte's Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Emily Brontë's Cathy (Juliette Binoche) and Heathcliff (Ralph Fiennes) fuel two generations of gothic romance on the Yorkshire moors.

programme.title: Whitney
programme.desc: Filmmaker Kevin Macdonald examines the life and career of singer Whitney Houston. Features never-before-seen archival footage, exclusive recordings, rare performances and interviews with the people who knew her best.

programme.title: Whitney: Can I Be Me
programme.desc: Filmmaker Nick Broomfield goes in search of the forces that made and then destroyed singer Whitney Houston, who has been described as having one of the greatest voices of the last 50 years.

programme.title: Vicious
programme.desc: A strange ritual soon unravels into a waking nightmare when a woman receives a mysterious box that comes with instructions to place three things inside: something you need, something you hate, and something you love.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: A widowed lawyer (Daniel Radcliffe) encounters ghostly goings-on at the foreboding estate of a recently deceased client.

programme.title: The Butcher's Wife
programme.desc: A folksy seaside clairvoyant (Demi Moore) marries a New York butcher (George Dzundza), moves to the city and charms her new neighbors.

programme.title: Up in the Air
programme.desc: A corporate downsizing expert (George Clooney) realizes he is developing real feelings for a frequent bedmate (Vera Farmiga) whose cache of travel miles and club cards rivals his own.

programme.title: The Time Traveler's Wife
programme.desc: Chicago librarian Henry De Tamble (Eric Bana) suffers from a rare genetic disorder that causes him to drift uncontrollably back and forth through time. On one of his sojourns, he meets the love of his life, Clare (Rachel McAdams), and they marry. But the problems and complexities of any relationship are multiplied by Henry's inability to remain in one time and place, so that he and his beloved are continually out of sync. - Rachel McAdams, Eric Bana, Arliss Howard, Ron Livingston, Stephen Tobolowsky (Romance, Drama, Science fiction)

programme.title: Daniela Forever
programme.desc: After his girlfriend dies in an accident, a grieving man joins a sleep trial that allows him to rebuild his life with her through the use of lucid dreams. - Henry Golding, Beatrice Grannò, Aura Garrido, Rubén Ochandiano, Nathalie Poza (Science fiction, Romance)

programme.title: Case 39
programme.desc: In her many years as a social worker, Emily Jenkins (Renée Zellweger) thinks she has seen it all -- until she meets 10-year-old Lilith (Jodelle Ferland) and the girl's cruel parents. When the parents try to harm the child, Emily assumes custody of Lilith while looking for a foster family. However, she soon finds that dark forces surround the seemingly innocent child, and the more she tries to protect Lilith, the more horrors she encounters. - Renée Zellweger, Jodelle Ferland, Ian McShane, Bradley Cooper, Kerry O'Malley (Horror, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Labor Day
programme.desc: At the tender age of 13, Henry Wheeler (Gattlin Griffith) grapples with the pains of adolescence while caring for his troubled, reclusive mother, Adele (Kate Winslet). One day while shopping for school supplies, Henry and Adele encounter Frank Chambers (Josh Brolin), an intimidating man but one who clearly needs their help. Frank convinces the two of them to take him into their home, but later it becomes clear that he is a convict who has escaped. Based on the novel by Joyce Maynard. - Kate Winslet, Josh Brolin, Gattlin Griffith, Tobey Maguire, Clark Gregg (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalsky, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space. - Sandra Bullock, George Clooney, Adam Cozens (Drama, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
programme.desc: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud. - Marisa Tomei, Sherry Cola, Ciara Bravo, Marco Pigossi, José María Yazpik (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Breaking up with Mark Darcy (Colin Firth) leaves Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) over 40 and single again. Feeling that she has everything under control, Jones decides to focus on her career as a top news producer. Suddenly, her love life comes back from the dead when she meets a dashing and handsome American named Jack (Patrick Dempsey). Things couldn't be better, until Bridget discovers that she is pregnant. Now, the befuddled mom-to-be must figure out if the proud papa is Mark or Jack. - Renée Zellweger, Colin Firth, Patrick Dempsey, Emma Thompson, Shirley Henderson (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: My Cousin Vinny
programme.desc: New York lawyer Vinny has never won a case. When his teenage cousin Bill and his friend Stan are accused of murder in a backwater Alabama town, it's up to the nervous Vinny to save him from jail, even though he's only ever tried personal injury cases before, and none of them successfully. - Joe Pesci, Marisa Tomei, Ralph Macchio, Mitchell Whitfield, Fred Gwynne (Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: House at the End of the Street
programme.desc: In search of a fresh start, divorcee Sarah (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter, Elissa (Max Thieriot), find their dream house in a small town. But when startling, unexplainable events begin, the pair learn that a chilling secret holds the town in its grip. Years earlier a girl killed her parents and disappeared, leaving a brother, Ryan (Max Thieriot), as the sole survivor. Elissa begins a relationship with Ryan, and the closer they get, the deeper they're all pulled into a dangerous mystery. - Jennifer Lawrence, Max Thieriot, Elisabeth Shue, Gil Bellows, Eva Link (Thriller, Horror)

programme.title: Blindness
programme.desc: When an epidemic of a disease known as the "white sickness" appears in her city, the wife (Julianne Moore) of a doctor is one of the few individuals left who still has sight. Sent to a government asylum along with her now-blind husband (Mark Ruffalo), she sees conditions deteriorate until civilization itself is in jeopardy, prompting her break-out of the asylum to lead a small group to freedom. - Julianne Moore, Mark Ruffalo, Alice Braga, Yusuke Iseya, Yoshino Kimura (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Mimic 2
programme.desc: Though well-meaning scientists thought they'd destroyed them all, a single gigantic, murderous Judas Breed cockroach, which is capable of taking on the shape of a human, is still on the loose. When the monster follows entomologist Remy Panos and kills her boyfriend, Jason Mundy, Remy becomes the prime suspect. Assigned to the case, detective Klaski grows convinced of her innocence -- and soon joins forces with her to hunt down the creature. - Alix Koromzay, Bruno Campos, Will Estes, Joseph Hodge, Jon Polito (Horror, Thriller)

(Baseball)

(Baseball)

programme.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
programme.desc: A Federation mission to the planet Ba'ku takes a dangerous turn when a malfunctioning android, Data (Brent Spiner), takes a cultural task force hostage. When Capt. Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his crew investigate, they uncover the truth about the Federation mission: It was actually a systematic ploy by the Son'a to displace the peaceful inhabitants of Ba'ku. Now Picard and his crew must thwart the plot even while experiencing strange side effects from exposure to the planet's surface. - Patrick Stewart, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner, LeVar Burton, Michael Dorn (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Thriller, Romance)

programme.title: Star Trek: Nemesis
programme.desc: Capt. Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) diverts the starship Enterprise from its scheduled trip to Cmdr. Riker (Jonathan Frakes) and Counselor Troi's (Marina Sirtis) wedding to negotiate a peace treaty with the Romulans. Picard is shocked when Shinzon (Tom Hardy), the new Praetor of the Romulans, admits to being a clone of him. When the crew members discover a break-in on their computer, they are forced into a life-or-death battle to stop Shinzon's Warbird before it can destroy the Earth. - Patrick Stewart, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner, LeVar Burton, Michael Dorn (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Thriller, Fantasy)

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Capt. James Kirk (William Shatner) and the crew of the USS Enterprise are carrying Klingon Chancellor Gorkon (David Warner) to Earth to negotiate a peace treaty with the United Federation of Planets. The ship appears to fire on a Klingon vessel, and Gorkon is killed in the subsequent confusion. Kirk and the ship's doctor, Leonard McCoy (DeForest Kelley), are arrested for murder, leaving Spock (Leonard Nimoy) to figure out who is behind the attack and save the negotiations. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, Walter Koenig (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Crime drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: On the Line
programme.desc: Kevin (Lance Bass) has everything going for him, but his lifelong lack of confidence keeps him from recognizing love and happiness -- even if it's sitting next to him. When Kevin meets the girl of his dreams, Abbey, on Chicago's L train, they connect immediately, but he lets this golden opportunity slip away by not having the courage to ask her for her name and number. Unable to find her, or forget her, Kevin and his buddies launch a massive campaign to locate Abbey. - Lance Bass, Joey Fatone, Emmanuelle Chriqui, GQ, James Bulliard (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The four nations of Air, Water, Earth and Fire lived in harmony until the Fire Nation declared war. A century later, there is still no end in sight to the destruction, then, an Avatar named Aang (Noah Ringer) discovers that he has the power to control the four elements. He joins forces with Katara (Nicola Peltz), a Waterbender, and her brother, Sokka, to restore balance and harmony to their world. - Noah Ringer, Dev Patel, Nicola Peltz, Jackson Rathbone, Shaun Toub (Fantasy, Adventure)

programme.title: A Wonderful Time of the Year
programme.desc: The Marsh family's getting together for their first Christmas Eve after three years of pandemic lockdown. - Kelly Kruger, Brendan Penny, Tom Arnold, Lisa Hartman, Tina Simmons (Comedy)

programme.title: She's the Man
programme.desc: Romantic complications ensue when a student poses as her twin brother and replaces him at his boarding school. - Amanda Bynes, James Kirk, Channing Tatum, Laura Ramsey, Emily Perkins (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Sabrina
programme.desc: Sabrina Fairchild is a chauffeur's daughter who grew up with the wealthy Larrabee family. She always had unreciprocated feelings for David, the family's younger son and playboy. But after returning from Paris, Sabrina has become a glamorous woman who gets David's attention. His older, work-minded brother Linus thinks their courtship is bad for the family business and tries to break them up -- but then he starts to fall for her too. - Harrison Ford, Julia Ormond, Greg Kinnear, Nancy Marchand, John Wood (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Some Kind of Wonderful
programme.desc: Keith Nelson (Eric Stoltz), an artsy high school outcast, tries to land a date with popular girl Amanda Jones (Lea Thompson) with some help from his tomboy best friend, Watts (Mary Stuart Masterson). However, his advances draw the ire of Amanda's snobby ex-boyfriend, Hardy Jenns (Craig Sheffer), who makes plans to get even. Matters are further complicated when Watts realizes she likes Keith as more than just a friend and tries to convince him to stop pursuing Amanda. - Eric Stoltz, Mary Stuart Masterson, Lea Thompson, Craig Sheffer, John Ashton (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Monster Summer
programme.desc: A mysterious force disrupts Noah and his friends' summer fun. They team up with a retired police detective to embark on a monstrous adventure to save their island. - Mel Gibson, Lorraine Bracco, Mason Thames, Kevin James, Nora Zehetner (Adventure, Horror)

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: Of the three Grace children, Jared has always been thought of as the troublemaker. So when strange things happen after his family's move to a relative's dilapidated estate, sister Mallory, twin brother Simon and their mother assume that Jared is behind it all. However, magical creatures roam the grounds, and they all want a special book that Jared has found: a field guide to fantastic creatures, penned by Arthur Spiderwick. - Freddie Highmore, Sarah Bolger, Mary-Louise Parker, David Strathairn, Joan Plowright (Children, Fantasy, Adventure, Drama, Action)

programme.title: Three Wishes
programme.desc: When single mother Jeanne Holman turns to avoid hitting a dog with her station wagon, she unwittingly hits bearded drifter Jack McCloud. Against the protests of her scandalized neighbors, Holman insists that the injured man stay at the Holman residence to heal. As the eccentric McCloud recovers from the accident, he becomes a positive influence on -- and an unexpected father figure to -- her young sons, Tom and Gunny. - Patrick Swayze, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Joseph Mazzello, Seth Mumy, David Marshall Grant (Fantasy)

programme.title: Walking Out
programme.desc: When a city teen travels to Montana to go hunting with his estranged father, the trip becomes a battle for survival when they encounter a grizzly bear. - Matt Bomer, Josh Wiggins, Bill Pullman, Alex Neustaedter, Lily Gladstone (Adventure, Drama)

programme.title: Son of Rambow
programme.desc: Though polar opposites, two schoolboys in the 1980s England work together on a homemade action film inspired by "Rambo: First Blood."

programme.title: The Perfect Score
programme.desc: High-school students (Erika Christensen, Chris Evans, Bryan Greenberg) conspire to steal the answers to their upcoming SATs.

programme.title: Regarding Henry
programme.desc: Two bullets force a career-driven Manhattan lawyer (Harrison Ford) to start life over with his loving wife (Annette Bening) and daughter.

programme.title: Bran Nue Dae
programme.desc: A rebellious young man runs away from home but returns after experiencing an amazing journey.

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: The mayor opposes a single mother (Juliette Binoche) who is opening a chocolate shop in his 1950s French village across from a church during Lent.

programme.title: The House of Mirth
programme.desc: In the early 20th century, a socialite (Gillian Anderson) cannot decide between marrying for wealth and status or marrying the man (Eric Stoltz) she loves.

programme.title: Where the Wild Things Are
programme.desc: Sent to bed without supper, a mischievous boy enters a land that grows out of his imagination and becomes king of the fantastic creatures who live there.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Aliens, believing actors to be real heroes, enlist cast members of a sci-fi TV series to help save their people.

programme.title: Good Burger
programme.desc: Teen misfits (Kel Mitchell, Kenan Thompson) at a modest burger joint face competition from a hamburger emporium across the street.

programme.title: Justin Bieber: Never Say Never
programme.desc: The young singer rises from humble beginnings as a street performer in Stratford, Ontario, to become a global superstar with a sold-out show at Madison Square Garden.

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: The mayor opposes a single mother (Juliette Binoche) who is opening a chocolate shop in his 1950s French village across from a church during Lent.

programme.title: Best in Show
programme.desc: Pampered pooches and their quirky owners converge on Philadelphia to compete in a prestigious dog show.

programme.title: Tommy Boy
programme.desc: A ne'er-do-well auto-parts heir must stop his father's widow from selling the business.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turns to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system. - Tim Allen, Sigourney Weaver, Alan Rickman, Tony Shalhoub, Sam Rockwell (Comedy, Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy)

programme.title: The Nutcracker: The Untold Story
programme.desc: Christmas in Vienna is a dull affair for 9-year-old Mary (Elle Fanning), until her beloved Uncle Albert (Nathan Lane) arrives and gives her a special gift: an enchanted nutcracker. On Christmas night the nutcracker -- named NC -- comes to life and takes Mary to its magical land of sugarplum fairies and talking toys. Mary discovers that the wondrous kingdom faces a dire threat from the evil Rat King, and when the nutcracker is kidnapped, she must rally her new friends to save NC. - Elle Fanning, Nathan Lane, John Turturro, Frances de la Tour, Charlie Rowe (Holiday, Musical, Fantasy)

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: The Brothers Grimm, Wilhelm and Jacob, are dysfunctional schemers who go from town to town putting on shows that convince inhabitants they are getting rid of demons. After one such scam, a mysterious man called Cavaldi brings them to a French general, who persuades them to battle the evil that has kidnapped 10 girls from a small village. During the investigation, the cynical Wilhelm and sensitive Jacob see things that point to real magic at work. - Matt Damon, Heath Ledger, Peter Stormare, Lena Headey, Jonathan Pryce (Fantasy, Adventure, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Justin Bieber: Never Say Never
programme.desc: A young singing sensation prepares to dazzle the crowd at a sold-out show at Madison Square Garden. Legions of adoring Bieber fans scream as he takes center stage for a memorable night of music. Concert footage mixes with home videos of Justin playing drums and showcasing his talent. - Boyz II Men (Documentary)

programme.title: Turtle Power: The Definitive History of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The release of Kevin Eastman and Peter Laird's groundbreaking comic in 1984 leads to a worldwide phenomenon. - Kevin Eastman, Barry Gordon, Cam Clarke, Townsend Coleman, James Avery (Children, Documentary)

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents. - Rod Steiger, Jeff Saumier, Ray Aranha, Mark Camacho, Jane Wheeler (Drama)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Dr. Indiana Jones, a renowned archeologist and expert in the occult, is hired by the U.S. Government to find the ark of the covenant, which is believed to still hold the Ten Commandments. Unfortunately, Hitler's agents are also after the ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion escape from various close scrapes in a quest that takes them from Nepal to Cairo. - Harrison Ford, Karen Allen, Paul Freeman, Wolf Kahler, Ronald Lacey (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: The second of the Lucas/Spielberg Indiana Jones epics is set a year or so before the events in Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy needs to retrieve a precious gem and several kidnapped young boys on behalf of a remote East Indian village. This time he teams up with a nightclub singer and a 12-year-old boy. - Harrison Ford, Kate Capshaw, Ke Huy Quan, Amrish Puri, Roshan Seth (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: An art collector appeals to Jones to embark on a search for the Holy Grail. He learns that another archaeologist has disappeared while searching for the precious goblet, and the missing man is his own father, Dr. Henry Jones. The artifact is much harder to find than they expected, and its powers are too much for those impure in heart. - Harrison Ford, Sean Connery, Denholm Elliott, Alison Doody, John Rhys-Davies (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: It's the height of the Cold War, and famous archaeologist Indiana Jones (Harrison Ford), returning from his latest adventure, finds out his job at Marshall College is in jeopardy. He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world. - Harrison Ford, Cate Blanchett, Shia La Beouf, Karen Allen, Ray Winstone (Family, Adventure, Action)

Unfortunately, the gentle paradise has more than its share of secrets, and Karl needs to call upon all the skills that made him a world-class detective in solving the murders that, even in this seemingly idyllic setting, continue to wash up on his shore. Cassandra, a local librarian, becomes Alberg's muse, foil and romantic interest. The show is based on the Edgar Award-winning, nine-book "Karl Alberg" series by acclaimed novelist L.R. Wright. - Rossif Sutherland, Kristin Kreuk, Marcia Gay Harden, Peter Gallagher (Crime drama)

programme.title: Nation's Dumbest
programme.desc: "Nation's Dumbest" is a celebrity competition series with a twisted premise: it's the only game show where winning is the last thing anyone wants. Famous faces are sent back to "summer school" and must relive the highs and humiliations of school life through a mix of brain-teasing pop quizzes, fast-paced physical challenges, and tests built on long-buried classroom knowledge. Rather than striving for a top prize, contestants battle to stay out of last place, because the worst performer is publicly humiliated with the unwanted title of "The Nation's Dumbest." Each week, the "smartest" celebrity graduates and leaves the competition, narrowing the field until a high-stakes final exam determines who ultimately fails their way to the infamous crown. The show channels a spirit of playful self-mockery, celebrating humor, humility, and the universal experience of not always getting it right. (Game show)

programme.title: Cold Case - Into the Blue
programme.desc: S6E23 - The team intensifies its efforts to solve the 2005 murder of a female cadet when the killer commits a shocking act against Lilly. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Jeremy Ratchford, Thom Barry (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - The Crossing
programme.desc: S7E1 - The team reviews the 1966 shipboard killing of a young woman previously thought to have jumped overboard; Maj. Kitchener (Daniel Baldwin) stands trial for running Rush's car off a bridge. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Jeremy Ratchford, Thom Barry (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - Hoodrats
programme.desc: S7E2 - The team investigates the 1995 murder of a teenager who left his dysfunctional home and gained fame on the streets for his skateboarding skills. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Jeremy Ratchford, Thom Barry (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - Jurisprudence
programme.desc: S7E3 - The team reopens the case of an innocent teenage inmate, killed in a juvenile detention center; Lilly reconnects with former love Saccardo. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Jeremy Ratchford, Thom Barry (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Charmed - Styx Feet Under
programme.desc: S7E5 - A demon tries to destroy his human half by killing his remaining blood relatives, so Paige casts a spell that inadvertently blocks all death from occurring, angering the Angel of Death (Simon Templeman). - Holly Marie Combs, Alyssa Milano, Rose McGowan, Brian Krause, Dorian Gregory (Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: Charmed - Once in a Blue Moon
programme.desc: S7E6 - The Charmed Ones try to prove Leo's worth to the Elders after their suspicions of him result in the appointment of a new Whitelighter. - Alyssa Milano, Rose McGowan, Holly Marie Combs, Brian Krause, Dorian Gregory (Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: Charmed - Someone to Witch Over Me
programme.desc: S7E7 - Agent Brody and Paige discover that the demon Sarpedon is capturing innocents' Guardian Angels and using them to protect himself from the New Power. - Alyssa Milano, Rose McGowan, Holly Marie Combs, Brian Krause, Dorian Gregory (Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: Charmed - Charmed Noir
programme.desc: S7E8 - Drawn into an unfinished novel set in the 1930s, Paige and Agent Brody find themselves running from gangsters in pursuit of the famed Burmese falcon. - Alyssa Milano, Rose McGowan, Holly Marie Combs, Brian Krause, Dorian Gregory (Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: Charmed - There's Something About Leo
programme.desc: S7E9 - The Charmed Ones, distracted by Leo's confession that he is an Avatar, allow a couple of demons to kill an innocent they were protecting, so Leo uses his powers to reverse time and vanquish the demons. - Alyssa Milano, Rose McGowan, Holly Marie Combs, Brian Krause, Dorian Gregory (Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: Cold Case - Soul
programme.desc: S7E4 - The team investigates the 1970 murder of a musician who kept his involvement with Philadelphia's music scene a secret from his strict preacher father; Lilly meets her teenage stepbrother. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Jeremy Ratchford, Thom Barry (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - WASP
programme.desc: S7E5 - The team investigates the 1944 murder of a woman who volunteered to fly noncombat missions for the Air Force; Lilly fixates on her nemesis. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Jeremy Ratchford, Thom Barry (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - Dead Heat
programme.desc: S7E6 - The team investigates the death of an accomplished 45-year-old jockey who disappeared within hours of losing a race that he had planned to be his last before retiring. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Jeremy Ratchford, Thom Barry (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - Read Between the Lines
programme.desc: S7E7 - The team investigates the 1991 murder of a 14-year-old foster child who was starting to establish herself as a talented rapper. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Jeremy Ratchford, Thom Barry (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - Chinatown
programme.desc: S7E8 - The team reopens the 1983 case of a teenager who was killed before he could get justice for his slain girlfriend. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Jeremy Ratchford, Thom Barry (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: The Flash
programme.desc: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. - Ezra Miller, Sasha Calle, Michael Shannon, Ron Livingston, Maribel Verdú (Action, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever. - Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Jack Black, Karen Gillan, Rhys Darby (Adventure, Action, Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: Practical Magic

programme.desc: S5E51 - It's time for a day out and Peppa, George, Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Suzy Sheep all go to visit Tiny Land; they see tiny dinosaurs, their favorite tiny landmarks and a tiny Miss Rabbit doing more jobs. (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Stamps
programme.desc: S5E52 - Grandpa Pig is showing Peppa and George his extensive stamp collection, which inspires them to send a postcard of their own; when Grandpa gets a very special stamp in the mail he misplaces it before it manages to find its way into his collection. (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Find a Genie
programme.desc: Rubble finds an old brass Jack in the Box with a Genie inside who grants him three wishes. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Tightrope Walker
programme.desc: Francois Turbot delights all of Adventure Bay by bravely walking a tightrope between the top of the bridge and the lookout tower; a flock of seagulls lands in Francois Turbot's way and threaten to mess up his whole act. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds an Art Museum; The Crew Builds a Giant Alphorn
programme.desc: S3E13 - The pups build a modular museum for River's changing art; they help Park Ranger Rose find Farmer Zoe's missing opera-singing goat, leading to building a giant alphorn for it. - Leslie Adlam, Jonathan Tan, Shazdeh Kapadia, Sabrina Jalees, Martin Roach (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go - Percy's Duck Dilemma/All for the Nest
programme.desc: Percy discovers the ducks are migrating, so he tries to get them to stay; a gull lays an egg on Cranky, and he refuses to move until it hatches. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Entertainment)

programme.title: Batwheels - Sizzie Strong
programme.desc: S3E4 - Bibi and Batgirl are surprised to run into Harley and Jestah at their favorite pop star's concert, and now they've all got to team up to save the show! (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Sam's Stylin' Salon
programme.desc: S2E20 - Sheepdog hires the Looney Builders to build him a salon. (Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Team Mekbots: Animal Rescue - Geyser Surprise and Other Adventures
programme.desc: Team Mekbots performs multiple rescues like a fawn from a geyser, Akkadi the Runaway Rhino and a snow leopard family from the edge of a cliff. (Animated, Children, Educational, Entertainment)

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Skyscraper Parts 1 & 2
programme.desc: S3E6 - Rubble and crew are building their biggest construction project ever, a skyscraper; and a job that huge calls for brand-new, mega-sized construction vehicles; but when Speed Meister sees the pups' big trucks, he calls in help from his big brother. - Leslie Adlam, Jonathan Tan, Shazdeh Kapadia, Sabrina Jalees, Martin Roach (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Care Bears: Unlock the Magic - Plunk to the Rescue

Colby the Dolphin is worried about his first check-up and swims far away to avoid it; Vida and Popcorn go on a wild dolphin chase to find him; and Colby finds out check-ups are great! (Children, Adventure, Animals)

programme.title: Shark Tale
programme.desc: Underachiever Oscar (Will Smith) is a pint-sized fish with grand aspirations. When mob-connected great white shark Frankie (Michael Imperioli) is accidentally killed, Oscar concocts a story with Frankie's peace-loving brother Lenny (Jack Black) that it was he who murdered the shark. Suddenly hailed "Sharkslayer" by his aquatic brethren, Oscar has bigger fish to fry when Frankie's father, mob boss Don Lino (Robert De Niro), dispatches his henchmen to track down his son's killer. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Zoo Diaries - Wambli the Bald Eagle
programme.desc: Wambli the bald eagle and Patsy the elephant. (Reality, Animals)

programme.title: Zoo Diaries - Patsy the Elephant
programme.desc: A keeper learns to handle birds of prey; Patsy still isn't behaving; Charles the silverback gorilla. (Reality, Animals)

programme.title: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball - The Distance
programme.desc: S1E3 - Gumball must find a way to save his relationship with Darwin after the boys are forced to live in separate rooms. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball - The Thing
programme.desc: S1E4 - Richard must retrace the memories of his day to figure out what the thing is, so Nicole's family dinner with Granny Jo Jo won't be another epic failure. - Sandra Dickinson, Kerry Shale (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons - Boo! Appetweet; Hole Gag: Plunger; Bubble Dum
programme.desc: S1E3 - Sweet victory turns into a nightmare when Sylvester fears he's haunted by Tweety's ghost; Daffy Duck faces off with a pesky piece of gum. (Animated, Children, Comedy)

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons - Pain in the Ice; Tunnel Vision; Pool Bunny
programme.desc: S1E4 - A hungry Sylvester sets his sights on Tweety the ice skater; on a scorching hot day, Bugs Bunny makes himself at home in Elmer Fudd's pool. (Animated, Children, Comedy)

programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs - Spoiler Orb; The Pandas Are Coming
programme.desc: Flint modifies Sam's weather-predicting orb to predict the future, but knowing their future isn't as fun as they thought it would be; after Swallow Falls falls under the panda's spell, it's up to Flint and Sam to find out what's really going on. (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs - Inventors Only; Clock-A-Doodle-Doom
programme.desc: Flint becomes excited when he discovers there's another inventor in town, but Sam suspects the inventor has an ulterior motive for befriending Flint; Flint combines an alarm with rooster DNA to create the ultimate alarm clock. (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Best & Bester - The Big Game/Get Your Skate On
programme.desc: S1E8 - Bester realizes that the only way to get his brother's attention when he is focused on the game is to get into the game; Best and Bester come up with a publicity stunt for the repair shop. (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Piñata Smashlings - Danger Looms
programme.desc: S1E25 - Tutti Bel learns that Looms make terrible pets. (Children, Adventure)

programme.title: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball - The Butts
programme.desc: S1E5 - Gumball must help Principal Brown have body confidence about his butt in order to be allowed to do his poem about butts at the Poetry Recital. - Sandra Dickinson, Kerry Shale (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball - The Traffic
programme.desc: S1E6 - The Wattersons must get Anais to Daisyland before the park closes for good. - Sandra Dickinson, Kerry Shale (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Responsible
programme.desc: Nicole and Richard are called to attend a PTA meeting, so Darwin and Gumball babysit Anais for the night; they try to behave responsibly, but all does not go to plan. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Dress
programme.desc: Gumball ends up wearing a dress to school one day, which has interesting repercussions when he inadvertently becomes the darling of Elmore High and assumes a new identity. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Teen Titans Go! - Dude Relax!
programme.desc: Robin's intensity is distracting the team, so they put him on forced hiatus where Beast Boy teaches him how to goof off and relax. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Teen Titans Go! - Pie Bros
programme.desc: Beast Boy takes a job at a pie shop so he can afford to buy Cyborg a birthday gift. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Teen Titans Go! - The Date
programme.desc: Robin poses as Speedy to sabotage his date with Starfire. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Teen Titans Go! - Gorilla
programme.desc: Beast Boy takes over when he is in Gorilla-mode and Robin must figure out how to get back on top. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy)
